about: Semantic overlay for the grammar checker (editor/checker). The main reference, handoff/liraasa_2_1_llm.json, stays clean; the checker merges this file in at load. Every key is a spelling in the reference, and tests/checker fails if one stops existing (a respelling must update this file). Author-reviewed data: edit here, never in code.

word_class._about: The grammatical class of each small word the clause template does not already name. Operators, copulas, valency operators, gome, la, the frame, topic, status, attitude, reciprocal and question words are read from clause.slots and clause.scope_operators, not from here.

subordinators_taking_a_noun_phrase._about: Subordinators that may also take a bare noun phrase instead of a clause.

correlative_role._about: What a correlative does in the clause, by its concept (the guide: place, time, manner and cause are adverbials; thing and person are nouns).

noun_to_adjective_role._about: ADR-0011: each noun form describes with its own adjective. Role codes from dictionary.role_codes.

give_type._about: 1.2:G26 give-type verbs: VERB THEME ala RECIPIENT, or VERB PRONOUN THEME. Found by gloss, reviewed 2026-10-17: kept the verbs of giving, lending, sending, owing, selling, paying, bringing, teaching and showing a thing to someone; left out folnidamvafa (to send up a stem), merama (to show mercy), relnura (to return: to come back), jurevija (to give thanks) and nimunia (to offer belonging).

say_type._about: Verbs of saying, writing and singing. With su they read as 'on', not 'about' (1.2:G30). Found by gloss.
say_type.ramulirara: to sing a song from memory

not_causative._about: Verbs that look causative in English ("make") but are not: they take an object, not an actor + verb. "Make someone do X" is the valency operator vaku (1.0:G14).
not_causative.farlafa: to make; to create — make a thing, never make someone do something; that is vaku

preposition_sense._about: What each preposition means, for the instrument rule (1.2:G33) and the English cross-check.

ko_combines._about: Verbs of mixing and joining: after these, ko + a substance is a partner in the mixture, not an instrument (canon: Cemoyanoca li marnapusa ko li miru, mix the flour with the water).

noun_class._about: Noun classes for the preposition rules. person, animal, thing, substance, place (anywhere or anywhen one can be in: night, darkness, shadow, a dream), abstract (qualities, feelings, sounds, a voice: the manner or means of an act). Reviewed 2026-10-17; the first 50 are the most frequent nouns in canon, the songs and the fixture, the rest are their near neighbours in canon after en and ko.
